learning_outcomes.text: Characterize and manipulate continuous signals, in the time domain;
Characterize and manipulate discrete signals, in the time domain;
Characterize and manipulate linear and time-invariant systems through their impulsive responses, for continuous time;
Characterize and manipulate linear and time-invariant systems through their impulsive responses, for discrete time;
Determine and manipulate the spectra of periodic and aperiodic continuous signals from their time domain expressions;
Determine and manipulate the spectra of periodic and aperiodic discrete signals from their time domain expressions;
Characterize and manipulate linear and time-invariant systems, in the frequency domain, through their transfer functions, for continuous time;
Characterize and manipulate linear and time-invariant systems, in the frequency domain, through their transfer functions, for discrete time.

syllabus_topics: Continuous-time and discrete-time signals - continuous time and discrete time, elementary signals, signal operations, signal classification, energy and power, symmetry properties.
Temporal analysis of continuous-time systems - linearity and time invariance, description with differential equations, block diagrams, impulsive response and convolution, causality, stability.
Temporal analysis of discrete-time systems - linearity and time invariance, description with difference equations, block diagrams, impulsive response and convolution, causality, stability.
Fourier analysis of signals and systems in continuous time - periodic and aperiodic signals in the frequency domain, transfer function, systems in the frequency domain.
Fourier analysis of signals and systems in discrete time - periodic and aperiodic signals in the frequency domain, transfer function, systems in the frequency domain.
assessment_rules: Assessment can be done throughout the semester or through a written final exam. For throughout the semester assessment, there are 2 written tests, each with a 50% weight on the final grade, and a minimum passing grade of 8/20 (i.e., 7.5) for each test. For exam-only assessment, the final exam (1st or 2nd or special exam periods) weights 100% and has a minimum passing grade of 9.5/20.
